entities.name: 1989 Soviet Air Force Ilyushin Il-76 crash
entities.label: Place
entities.summary: On October 18, 1989, a Soviet Air Force Ilyushin Il-76, flying from Nasosnaya Air Base in SSR Azerbaijan to Zhovtneve Air Base in SSR Ukraine, crashed into the Caspian Sea. All 57 people on board were killed. The aircraft was carrying paratroopers from the 98th Guards Airborne Division. It is the deadliest aviation accident to have occurred in Azerbaijan.
